_comment: Weapon/armour shortlist boosts (LoadoutOptimizer.candidateScore): pieces whose value lives in the DPS model, not raw stats, so the top-N cut must not drop them. Keyed by style (or 'all'); each block lifts a piece once (first matching name substring). Void: the set carries ~zero raw stats, so without a boost the zero-score prune drops the helm/gloves and a stocked bank's cut drops the top/robe (2026-07-17). The Obligator: its Lunge re-rolls (DpsCalculator) are invisible to raw stats (2026-10-20). 'wilderness' applies in the Wilderness and 'revenant' at revenants, charged versions only (the +50% passives and the incoming-nullify, DpsCalculator).
